content:
Anthropic announced last month its plans to expand Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad, with the first rollout being to Anthropic's most expensive paid plan.

As of today, Anthropic says Claude Cowork is now fully available on mobile and desktop across all paid plans.

To learn more about the rollout of Anthropic's Claude Cowork mobile version, click here.

Separately, OpenAI has launched its own offering, ChatGPT Work, available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.
